top_signals.title: Treasury Takes Less Than Expected at Buyback, Pushing Up Yields
top_signals.summary: The US government repurchased fewer 10- to 20-year securities than the maximum amount it outlined under Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s expanded buyback program, driving US government debt yields higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Capt. Girish Munjal, Content Director, MarinePALS on the impact of the PSC CIC on Cargo Securing.
top_signals.summary: Capt. Girish Munjal, Head of Content, MarinePALS, explains the significance of the joint Tokyo MOU–Paris MoU CIC on cargo securing, highlighting the importance of understanding the requirements, applying them correctly, and ensuring cargo is safely loaded, stowed and secured. ﻿ Source: MarinePALS

top_signals.title: Microsoft Excel KB5002914 update breaks copy and paste for some users
top_signals.summary: Microsoft Excel users report that this week's KB5002914 Office security update is breaking copy-and-paste operations and formula dragging, with affected users saying that removing or rolling back the update restores normal functionality. [...]
